title: openssl cmp -cmd cr corrupts UTF-8 subject names
root_cause: Hardcoded use of MBSTRING_ASC when calling parse_name
reproduction_command: $ openssl cmp -cmd cr -config "" -unprotected_requests -secret pass: -recipient / -subject "/CN=Dämlich" -newkey key.pem -reqout_only req.der
notes: Candidate C harness translated from a CLI PoC. Strict reproduction requires the original input artifact.
validation_notes: The generated C harness was translated from the original CLI command and compiled/executed using a placeholder local input. This validates the harness structure but does not strictly reproduce the original issue because the original PoC input artifact has not been recovered.
